changes.summary: Wait for pending claims during worker shutdown and account for reserved concurrency

changes.detail: Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 renamed every lifecycle hook to its `on` form and removed setup/cleanup (now onStart/onStop). This package now builds and tests against Elysia 2.0.0-rc.0 and requires `elysia ^2.0.0-rc.0`, which also accepts later release candidates and 2.0.0. The queue plugin now starts its worker in onStart and stops it in onStop (setup/cleanup were removed), so the worker follows the server's own start and stop.

migration.instruction: Upgrade `elysia` and every `@elysia/*` package to 2.0.0-rc.0 or later, then rename lifecycle hooks in your own server: request → onRequest, beforeHandle → onBeforeHandle, afterHandle → onAfterHandle, afterResponse → onAfterResponse, error → onError, parse → onParse, transform → onTransform; setup/cleanup → onStart/onStop. absolutejs/scripts codemods/elysia-rc-hooks.ts does the renames (run it before upgrading Elysia).

changes.summary: Add explicit non-retryable job failures preserving terminal errors without repeated execution
Republish the verified worker kind-routing fix after npm accepted 0.8.3 but left it unavailable and unlisted in staging
Keep jobs pending for workers with matching handlers using atomic kind-filtered claims and an optional strict adapter capability gate
Add atomic claim-fenced completion and failure, unique in-memory claim tokens and a strict worker capability gate so expired attempts cannot overwrite newer jobs
Count expired worker claims toward maxAttempts so repeated process death cannot retry a job indefinitely
